categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and cache actions to add a native macOS arm64 test job.
categories.rationale: Enables native CI execution of release-like cross-compiled macOS arm64 binaries. The PR description notes that cross-compiled macOS binaries are currently never run in CI, allowing platform runtime failures like #35771 to go undetected.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and enables unit test suite execution on native macOS arm64 runners.
categories.rationale: Extends test infrastructure to run test_bitcoin and test_bitcoin-qt on native macOS arm64 hardware. As noted in the description, this provides test signal to catch realistic platform-specific runtime crashes before release.
